name: Mai x Mai? Sunao ni Narenai Imouto-tachi to no Ecchi na Kyoudou Seikatsu
original_name: 妹×妹？ 素直になれない妹達とのえっちな共同生活
source:
Our protagonist, Ren, and his younger sister, Rio, essentially live together.
Lately, Rio has been acting strangely aloof, but they've been living a relatively peaceful life.

Then, one day on a holiday—
Rio, in a panic, wakes him up (as usual), rudely.
He rushes to the living room and finds his sister's best friend, Yuuri, there.
When he asked her what was going on, she said,

"As of today, I'm your little sister,"

And so, without really understanding what was going on, they ended up living together.

For some reason, the number of little sisters suddenly increased.
And the real little sister became even more grumpy.
But as Yuuri clinged to Ren, Rio's attitude gradually changed.

"...It's all your fault, big brother."

Then, what should have been peaceful days suddenly become exciting...
And so, their lives turn sweet and erotic.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1010738]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公莲与妹妹莉绪基本上一直住在一起。
最近，莉绪的态度有些冷淡，但他们仍过着相对平静的生活。

然而，某个假日——
莉绪慌慌张张地像往常一样粗暴地把他叫醒。
他冲进客厅，发现妹妹的好友优里也在那里。
当他询问发生了什么时，她回答：

“从今天起，我就是你的妹妹。”

就这样，在完全没弄清状况的情况下，他们开始共同生活。

不知为何，妹妹的数量突然增加了。
真正的妹妹也变得更加暴躁。
但当优里黏在莲身边时，莉绪的态度逐渐发生了变化。

“……都怪哥哥。”

原本平静的日子突然变得令人兴奋……
他们的生活，就这样变得甜蜜又淫靡。

（来源：[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1010738]Getchu[/url]）
